materials_exhausted.note: Bounded re-review reopened XML, pdftotext article text, OA package members, DOCX/PDF supplements, locator indexes, and linked APD6/merged database rows. Remaining cautions are curated conflicts, not open material blockers.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2 recovered primary-source activity rows, worker-4 preserved one APD6 sequence conflict, and worker-6 re-adjudicated the paper as publication-grade with cautions after source review.
summary: AtMP1 and AtMP2 are source-supported synthetic peptides from A. testudineus mucus fraction F2. Activity values are preserved from primary text; APD6:AP05858 remains a sequence-conflict caution rather than a clean verified record.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6:AP05857 matches the primary AtMP1 sequence and activity text. APD6:AP05858 links to the correct paper and matching activity values but conflicts with the primary AtMP2 sequence, so it is retained as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: 18 primary-source activity rows were recovered from results/discussion prose and figure captions. F2 fraction rows are retained as context and synthetic peptide rows carry APD6 links where applicable.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Apoptosis, RT2 PCR, pull-down, LC-MS/MS, and docking evidence were separated by evidence class so computational support is not overclaimed as direct mechanism evidence.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source AtMP2 sequence is TGIATSGLATFTLHTGSLAPAT, while APD6 merged sequence row gives TGIATSGATFTLHTGSLAPAT.
F2 fraction activity supports peptide discovery context but is not a sequence-resolved database peptide record.
Docking results are retained as computational support alongside direct apoptosis and pull-down assays.
